geeklist.title: Clearing off the Shelves Auction - Ends Sunday 1/25
geeklist.description:
Bidding is in whole dollar increments.
Shipping - US only. Buyer will be responsible for shipping charges (you pay what I pay at the post office). Local Pickup is available (saves you money). I am shipping out of 07430. Shipping quotes: Small box games - USPS small flat rate $12.60 big box games = USPS medium flat rate $21.60 Books ship via media mail or are combined with games to ship ****If regional (non-flat rate) shipping is cheaper, I will use that and refund the excess to you****
All games will have the condition and starting bid listed.
This auction will close between 955pm-1015pm on January 25, 2026.
All auction wins will go through GeekMarket for BGG.
Payment methods - Venmo or Paypal.
If you have any questions, please comment or geekmail me.
geeklist.comment: Thank you to the MetaList for Geeklist Auctions. Subscribe to stay up to date on Geeklist Auctions - https://boardgamegeek.com/geeklist/66420/metalist-for-geeklist-auctions
